description: `praxis/storage.py` is the only module that knows where the user's data lives, and it is built so a new backend is a resolver plus an availability check — never a new path computation in any caller. Three ship (`app`, `drive`, `cloud`) and `register_backend(kind, resolver, available=..., writable=..., on_select=..., sync=...)` is the seam that plugs one in: `_RESOLVERS` / `_AVAILABLE` (plus `_WRITABLE` / `_ON_SELECT` / `_SYNC`) and `FIELDS` / `BLURBS` (the settings form's single source of truth, rendered by `ui/src/StorageSettings.tsx`, which knows no backend by name). This tasklist adds at least one further backend on that seam — following the same disciplines the shipped ones hold: a stricter-than-local availability check where an unplugged/unreachable target would otherwise recreate a decoy folder, a stored secret reported as `set: true` never by value, a sync that never deletes and merges by content digest, and the `writable()` 503 middleware in `launcher/app.py` gating every non-GET write. Scope: `praxis/storage.py` (+ a sync module if the backend mirrors, like `praxis/cloud.py` over `praxis/s3.py`), `storage.FIELDS`/`BLURBS`, and `tests/` with a loopback fake for any remote protocol (as `tests/mocks3.py` does).
warmup: echo 'A backend is a resolver in _RESOLVERS + an availability check in _AVAILABLE via register_backend — NEVER a new path computation in a caller. Secrets report set:true, sync never deletes, writable() gates writes — see CLAUDE.md "Storage".'

userStories.title: A new backend added through the register_backend seam
acceptanceCriteria: At least one further backend is added via `register_backend` — a resolver in `_RESOLVERS` plus an availability check in `_AVAILABLE` (and `_WRITABLE`/`_ON_SELECT`/`_SYNC` if it needs them) — with NO new path computation in any caller: `curriculum.subjects_dir()` and `progress.progress_dir()` stay one-line delegates and follow the new root unchanged.

The backend's availability is stricter-than-local where a vanished/unreachable target would otherwise let a decoy folder be created on the internal disk (the `_drive_available` immediate-parent-must-exist rule), and `select_backend()` resolves + checks + creates before it stores so a bad target leaves the app pointed where it already was.

Gate green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` passes, including a test that resolves the new backend, writes a subject/progress artifact under its root and reads it back — plus its availability failing cleanly (no decoy folder).

userStories.title: Settings-form and write-gate discipline for the new backend
acceptanceCriteria: `storage.FIELDS`/`BLURBS` describe the new backend so `ui/src/StorageSettings.tsx` renders its form with no backend-by-name knowledge; a stored secret is reported `set: true` never by value, and a blank secret field means keep the stored one (`merge_options`).

The `writable()` 503 middleware in `launcher/app.py` gates every non-GET write for the new backend exactly as for the others (`/api/storage` exempt because it is the fix), and if the backend mirrors + syncs, the sync never deletes at either end and merges by content digest — proved by a loopback fake for its protocol the way `tests/mocks3.py` serves S3, wiping the mirror and reading the work back in a second process.
Gate green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` passes (backend + launcher API with the launch extra), `npm run build` in ui/ and `cargo build` in src-tauri/ pass if touched.
